title: How is Genghis Khan connected to SpongeBob?
description:
Five Great Khans, two pages of a medieval Marco Polo manuscript, 82 popes, the Obamas and a London soccer drill connect Genghis Khan to SpongeBob SquarePants.

Genghis Khan → Kublai Khan → Niccolò Polo → Pope Gregory X → Pope Francis → Michelle Obama → SpongeBob SquarePants

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Genghis Khan → Kublai Khan (5 portraits, every holder): Genghis Khan founded the Mongol Empire, and his grandson Kublai became its fifth Great Khan.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:YuanEmperorAlbumGenghisPortrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:YuanEmperorAlbumOgedeiPortrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:G%C3%BCy%C3%BCk_Khan_enthroned_(Biblioth%C3%A8que_nationale_de_France,_Suppl%C3%A9ment_Persan_206_f.136).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:M%C3%B6ngke_enthroned._Tarikh-i_Jahangushay-i_Juvaini,_1438,_Shiraz.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:YuanEmperorAlbumKhubilaiPortrait.jpg
2. Kublai Khan → Niccolò Polo: A 15th-century French manuscript painted Kublai Khan receiving the Venetian merchant brothers Niccolò and Maffeo Polo.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PoloBrotherAndKubilai.JPG
3. Niccolò Polo → Pope Gregory X: The same book paints the Polos with Pope Gregory X, who sent them back to Kublai in 1271.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NoccoloAndMaffeoPoloWithGregoryX.JPG
4. Pope Gregory X → Pope Francis (8 portraits, every holder): From Gregory X, the 184th pope, the line runs unbroken to the 266th, Pope Francis.
   Photo, Public domain / CC0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL 1.2 / unknown: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gregory_X,_Buffalmacco,_Arezzo_Cathedral.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Giotto_-_Bonifatius_VIII_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pedro_Berruguete_-_Portrait_of_Pope_Sixtus_IV_della_Rovere_-_1916.815_-_Cleveland_Museum_of_ArtFXD.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_IX,_by_Adolphe_Braun,_1875.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_XII_with_tabard,_by_Michael_Pitcairn,_1951_(retouched).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ADAMELLO_-_PAPA_-_Giovanni_Paolo_II_-_panoramio_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Benedykt_XVI_(2010-10-17)_2.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_Korea_Haemi_Castle_19_(4x5_cropped).jpg
5. Pope Francis → Michelle Obama: In 2015, Barack and Michelle Obama welcomed Pope Francis to the White House.
   Photo by Amanda Lucidon, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_and_the_Obamas_at_the_White_House.jpg
6. Michelle Obama → SpongeBob: And in 2012 in London, Michelle Obama kicked a goal past SpongeBob, with David Beckham cheering.
   Photo by Tim Whitby/Getty Images for Nickelodeon, Fair use (commentary): https://www.cbsnews.com/pictures/michelle-obama-at-the-olympics

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
